cards.rationale: Bad Left Hook describes the first Dubois-Wardley fight as a brilliant, momentum-swinging contest that included a knockdown in the opening 10 seconds before Dubois earned an 11th-round stoppage. That history leaves a real Wardley upset path, but the same source stresses the extraordinary punishment Wardley absorbed and the unusually short five-month turnaround. Bovada directly lists Wardley +285 against Dubois -425, which normalizes Wardley near +312 fair; BetUS is shorter at +245 against -385, around +274 fair. An aggregator-only best of +320 is near the sharp paired benchmark, not a meaningful overlay. The thesis becomes actionable only if a named sportsbook directly confirms +400 or better.
